selection_reason: Highest recorded validation development rank with balanced High/Critical recall, under/severe/over-triage, macro F1, Brier and stability. The cost-sensitive Logistic Regression alternative reduces under-triage but increases over-triage and lowers macro F1; it is not substituted after seeing test outcomes.
holdout_limitations: The full labelled cohort was explored in earlier EDA/hypothesis analyses. This is a newly reserved modelling holdout, not fully blinded to prior exploration. No baseline model transform, prediction, evaluation, or tuning uses test requests.
safety_notice: Experimental output. Not a clinical decision.
